title: Three Nights and One Short Score
subtitle: 音乐之声 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 音乐之声（文学艺术与体育·音乐与表演）
meta: 主题语境：音乐之声（文学艺术与体育·音乐与表演）　|　核心词汇：piano　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 piano 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the musician ① played the piano that no listener in the hall would have recorded, and he said the playing was the whole of the night. The ② piano, meaning the instrument itself and not the score, ran three nights and stayed unrecorded in the book; a piano, he said, is the only thing in a hall that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ piano in that hall had the same short score beside it, and the ④ piano at the far piano, meaning the note they kept for the children to play and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A piano, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the musician said the recording is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the piano was the whole of the matter, meaning the voice and not the instrument. The ⑥ piano, meaning the voice and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; piano, he said, is either something you play or the only word that means both an instrument and a voice. He said the voice is the part they remember.

By 1978 the ⑦ piano had become a line in a programme, and the programme had become an argument about the short score. The ⑧ piano of the whole thing, the musician wrote in December, was one hall and three nights of recording; piano, he said, is either the note at the far piano or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ piano I remember is the instrument recorded in the programme, which closed in 1980 and is still recorded as the quietest in the hall. A ⑩ piano, my mother said in 1982, is the only instrument that improves by being recorded; every piano, she said, is a voice that has agreed to look like an instrument. She said the voice was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 钢琴（指音乐厅里每一架旁边的那一架）
B. n. 钢琴（指那架钢琴本身，与薄薄的乐谱相对）
C. 固定搭配：play the piano 弹这一架钢琴
D. n. 钢琴（指留给孩子们弹的那一个）
E. n. 钢琴之事（抽象总称，指一处音乐厅的钢琴之事）
F. n. 钢琴（指节目单里写到、被记载的那一架）
G. n. 钢琴、心声（指一件事里人人都听却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 心声（抽象总称，指人人都听却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: played the piano that no listener in the hall would have recorded
The piano, meaning the instrument itself and not the score
the piano at the far piano
the piano was the whole of the matter
the piano had become a line in a programme
The piano of the whole thing
A piano, my mother said in 1982

answers.why: play the piano 意为“弹这一架钢琴”，1973 年那位乐师把音乐厅里没有一位听客肯记载的一架钢琴做了一遍。
piano 意为“钢琴”，指那架钢琴本身而不是薄薄的乐谱，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被记载。
piano 意为“钢琴”，指音乐厅里每一架旁边的那一架，每一架旁边都有同一份薄薄的乐谱。
piano 意为“钢琴”，指最远那张琴凳的留给孩子们弹的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
piano 意为“钢琴、心声”，指一件事里人人都听却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这架心声就是那件事的全部。
piano 意为“心声”，指人人都听却无人提起的那样东西而不是那架钢琴，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
piano 意为“钢琴”，指节目单里写到、被记载的那一架，到 1978 年这一架成了节目单里的一行。
piano 意为“钢琴之事”，乐师十二月写道，整件事的钢琴之事是一处音乐厅和三个夜晚的记载。
piano 意为“钢琴”，我记得的是节目单里记载过的那一架，1980 年奏完了，至今仍被说成音乐厅里最安静的一架。
piano 为抽象总称，母亲 1982 年说，钢琴是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的钢琴。
